title: Kth Largest Element in an Array
keyIdea: Keep the k largest numbers in a min-heap of size k: push the first k, then for each later number bigger than the top, pop the top and push it. The top is the k-th largest.

approaches.name: Sort
approaches.why: Sorts everything even though only one position matters.

approaches.name: Quickselect (3-way partition)
approaches.idea: Partition around a random pivot into < / == / >; keep only the side that contains index n − k.
approaches.why: Each step throws away part of the array; a bad pivot streak can still make it quadratic.

approaches.name: Min-heap of size k
approaches.idea: Push the first k; for the rest, if element > top: pop, push. Return top.
approaches.why: Each of n numbers does at most one pop and one push on a heap of size k; guaranteed, no bad cases.

quiz.q: Why a min-heap to find the k-th LARGEST?
options: Its top is the smallest of the k largest, which is exactly the k-th largest

quiz.q: When does a later number enter the heap?
options: Only when it is bigger than the current top
Quickselect is O(n) on average but O(n²) in the worst case; the heap is always O(n log k)
